points: Your site offers subscribe and save, yet 0 of 28 ads mention it, so a new buyer has no reason to act. Open three new ads with that offer in the first line and print the 10% saving on the creative.

0 of 30 ads mention a subscription, though the site offers subscribe and save. Hand sanitizer runs out, and buyers who never hear of the saving rebuy only when they remember. Run two retention ads with subscription saving as the headline.

Your site shows prices from $10 to $108, yet 0 of 30 ads mention price or cost. Shoppers want the number before they click. Lead one ad with the price per unit and what it compares to, in the first line.
None of your 30 ads carries a proof number, so a first click has nothing to trust. Collect one real figure, such as a review count or orders shipped, and lead one ad with it.
